description: MCP server configuration for the Zava AI MicroHack. Place this file at the repo root (or copy to .vscode/mcp.json for VS Code workspace-scoped config). Loaded automatically by VS Code Copilot and GitHub Copilot agent mode.

zava.description: Zava custom MCP server — exposes product, order, customer, inventory, knowledge and evidence tools backed by the data/ seed files.

zava-dev.description: Zava MCP server in dev mode (tsx, no build required). Use during development. Requires: cd src/mcp-zava && npm install.

microsoft-learn-docs.description: Microsoft Learn / Azure documentation MCP server. Provides up-to-date reference docs for Azure services, SDK APIs, and best practices. No authentication required.
